source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: After traveling together for some time together as merchant guards, our mish mash of travelers; Karsemine the Tiefling Ranger, Stafl the 'Human' Bard, Caelynn the Half Elf Sorcerer, Ephanna the Kenku Warlock, Bonogo the Bugbear Rogue, and Baergrom the Dwarf Fighter, found themselves outside the town of Stonebridge.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: The town of Stonebridge is known for very few things, in fact Stonebridge is hardly known.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: It has the Stonebridge over the river [River name], it's tavern The River's Edge Pub run by Grishna the Half-orc, and that's about it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: It did have a job board, and most importantly the local brewer Glowkindle had posted a help request on the jobs board and spread word all around town of his need of a band of mercenaries to help clean up some rats.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: While doing some drinking at the Riv'ers Edge Pub to wash away the road, Grishna was quick to share that Glowkindle had been through, where the The Wizard's Tower Brewing Co was located.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Up river, west at the big rock, walk till you see it.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo, having very little awareness or care for the cost of things, and greatly enjoying the beer, bought a Firkin of ale for two gold.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: He quite enjoyed the hike to the brewery.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Grishna was true to her word, the directions were sound.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: There was a clear trail along the river to an enormous boulder.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: As the group approached it resolved into what must have been the foot of a once enormous statue.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Or a mad sculptures dedication to someone's foot, probably the former but who really knows with art anyway.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Another few hours walk away from the river along the trail led the group to the Wizard's Tower Brewing Company.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Bustling with activity, and smelling of brewing, the fine tap room lit by magical crystals, was empty except for the troupe of gnomes busily brewing.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Within they met Glowkindle who told them, a bit about the issue at hand.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Giant rats had assaulted his excavation crew after they broke through a wall expanding the fermentation cellar.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: For a healthy prize of 25 gold pieces each, the team agreed to clear out the rats.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Which was significantly harder than expected, led to multiple folk going down, a mysterious cat owl being tossed into the room to help, a lot of blood from rats and teammates, and many, many, many health potions being downed.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: A fine first combat to bring the team together!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Finally, free to explore the team found a beautifully tiled hallway, a trapped mosaic on the ground, a room full of broken alchemical tools.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: As Karsemine wisely searched the room, eventually looking up, she made eye contact with another resident of the shatter mages tower.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 01 - Stonebridge and Glowkindle Rats.md
lexical_plain: Some kind of flaming magma infused spider monstrosity.
